info.name: HerHealthGPT backend
info.description:
Manual API testing for the HerHealthGPT backend.

Import this collection and the `HerHealthGPT — local` environment, start the API with `make db-up && make migrate && make serve`, then send the requests. `baseUrl` comes from the environment so the same requests work against staging later.

As the Accounts endpoints land (register, verify, sign in, …) add them as folders here; the health check is the skeleton.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness of the service and its database.

request.description: Returns 200 with {"status":"ok"} when the service can reach PostgreSQL, and 503 with {"status":"unavailable"} when it cannot. The check performs a real database round-trip, so a 503 means the database, not just the process, is the problem.
